subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for requireMention channels, and what consent, retention, cost, and visibility limits should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but silently processing unmentioned speech and retaining derived transcripts changes privacy/security and configuration policy rather than only repairing broken existing behavior.

options.title: Define scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Wait for cross-channel media policy
options.body: Keep this as product input until maintainers define shared media-retention semantics across Discord, Signal, WhatsApp, and Telegram.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should never be transcribed or retained without direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Define scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal is prior Discord preflight review/merge history plus the product/security nature of the decision.
